description: Read a search's status, cited answer, coverage counts and top quotes. Free. Pass `turn_id` to read a specific follow-up answer, otherwise the latest turn is returned. A finished search returns at once; a running one is held open for up to 55s and returns as soon as it finishes, so call it again until status is "completed".

search_id.description: The search id returned by `search` or `list_searches`.

turn_id.description: A turn id from `search`, `ask` or `generate_hooks`. Default: the latest turn.

name: get_search
title: Get a search
